# AdonisJS suite examples and prompts

## Meta prompts

- Route this AdonisJS 7 task to the right specialist skill and explain the safest workflow order.
- I have an AdonisJS 7 task but I am not sure whether the main risk is architecture, backend implementation, Tuyau contract design, testing, or review. Pick the right skill first.
- Coordinate this AdonisJS 7 workflow from design to ship using the suite of specialized skills.

## Example asks

### New feature

I need a new AdonisJS 7 feature. First decide the architecture, then implement it idiomatically, then define the minimum safe tests, then review whether it is safe to ship.

### Typed API

I need a new typed API flow in AdonisJS 7 + Tuyau. Pick the correct workflow so the contract is stable and properly tested.

### PR gate

I have an AdonisJS 7 PR. Route it through the right review and testing path so we can decide PASS, PASS WITH FIXES, or BLOCK.
